svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Credit enhancement calculation engine
svg.desc: Process: inputs as of the issue date feed a frozen static set; a credit model per rating gives stressed defaults and severity; sixteen scenarios per rating run through the monthly cash-flow waterfall; each class attachment is found by bisection; a sensitivity cushion is added by re-solving each estimate; challengers and market checks report; the deal is issued or the pool is re-selected.
svg.text: Credit enhancement calculation engine
Sample deal figures in brackets (warehouse deal, issue date 19 Jul 2025). Generic model built on public concepts; not an agency model.

g.text: Market data as of issue date
OIS curve, Bank Rate, note margins,
deal terms of public prime issues
each a dated data set; versions in
force on the date are used
shock, score calibration, rate stress size

svg.text: Credit model, per rating level
loan score → pool PD → rating default rate (Vasicek, at the PD a rating allows)
× loan severity (market value decline, forced-sale discount, costs, floors)
= credit coverage, the loss each rating must survive (AAA: 19.3% defaults × 34.1% severity = 6.6% of pool)
Scenario grid, per rating: 16 deterministic paths
defaults front- or back-loaded × prepayment 0 / 5 / 10 / 20% × Bank Rate up or down
fixed loan rates never reprice; the stressed Bank Rate path moves SVR loans, the swap and the notes
Monthly loan-level waterfall, for a candidate stack
revenue: net swap, fees, class interest, PDL cures, reserve top-up, Class Z
principal: sequential, A first; principal covers revenue shortfalls via the PDL
enhancement used in order: excess spread, reserve (amortises), subordination
sources = uses every month and over life; swap on its issue-date schedule (no break payments)
Size each class by bisection
lowest attachment with no loss in any of its rating's 16 scenarios
floor: Class Z funds the reserve and day-1 costs (Class A stress-test attachment 7.0%)
next candidate
Sensitivity cushion on the estimates only
each estimate to its adverse value, attachment re-solved; root-sum-square of the rises
(+2.66pp, so Class A attaches at 9.7%; with the 1.5% reserve, 11.2% enhancement)
Challengers (report, never loosen)
joint adverse check (must pass); reverse stress
break-even defaults and value decline
EL-based view; Monte Carlo (off by default)
swap ends at month 12; rate move before issue
implied tranche PD vs the rating's target
Issue tests and market terms
excess spread after the swap above the minimum
tolerance to a rate move before issue
terms against public deals issued by the date:
step-up, call, reserve, Class A share, enhancement
outside the range = flagged for review, not failed
Viable: issue · not viable: re-select the pool
not viable: re-select the pool and repeat
